linguisticAccuracy.note: All canonical and accepted Spanish forms accurately express the English meaning for one informal addressee. Vos vivís and tú vives are correctly formed; subject omission is grammatical; and aquí/acá remain semantically appropriate in this location statement.

ambiguity.note: The structured context fixes English you as one person addressed informally, excluding usted, ustedes, and vosotros interpretations. Canonical and accepted forms now cover the natural subject-present and subject-dropped realizations within each supported profile.

pedagogyAndCefr.note: The unit is appropriate for A1: one short declarative sentence, a regular -ir present-tense verb, a basic location adverb, and a clearly bounded second-person singular contrast. The regional alternatives add no conceptual or syntactic overload.

dialectConsistency.note: es-AR consistently teaches Rioplatense vos plus vivís with acá as the profile preference while accepting aquí. es-419 uses broadly intelligible tuteo as its default and retains complete country-sensitive voseo and aquí/acá combinations. es-ES uses standard informal singular tuteo with the usual Peninsular aquí form.

culturalSafety.note: The home-and-location statement is culturally neutral and contains no stereotype, sensitive personal inference, unsafe instruction, or misleading cultural claim.
